notes:
This release makes the macros accurate on any screen and stops a crash.

The skill cooldown detector now works at any screen size and resolution, not only 1920x1080. Before this, on a different monitor it silently did nothing and never said why. Auto buffs can also be calibrated at any resolution now, so setup works on a friend's machine, not only on one exact monitor.

The tool can read the game while it sits on another screen, so cooldown detection and buff detection keep working when the game is not the front window. Sending keys while the game is behind is a separate step that has to be proven on your own PC first, so it stays off until then and the game has to be in front to send.

A Windows error box that could appear is gone. Any unexpected problem is now caught, written to last-error.txt beside the app, and the window keeps running instead of closing on you.

Timing is steadier. Fast rows no longer drift slower over time, a cast gap of zero is refused, and a row can no longer fire twice when you alt tab.

The window keeps its layout at 125 and 150 percent Windows scaling.

Saved characters are safer. Your calibration is no longer lost when you load a character, backups no longer overwrite each other, and a settings file written by a newer version is never silently downgraded.
